steps.code: python -m pip install -U gallery-dl · brew install gallery-dl

steps.en: Pass it a gallery, profile or tag-search URL
steps.zh: 把图集、主页或标签搜索的网址交给它

steps.en: Matches the URL to the site's extractor
steps.zh: 按网址匹配到该站点的提取器

steps.en: Pages through the whole gallery, collecting each file's URL and metadata
steps.zh: 翻完整个图集，收集每个文件的直链和元数据

steps.en: Downloads originals under ./gallery-dl/, named from metadata, skipping files it already has
steps.zh: 把原图下到 ./gallery-dl/ 下，按元数据命名，已有的跳过

value.en: A whole gallery lands on disk in one command, and reruns fetch only what is new
value.zh: 一条命令把整个图集落盘，再跑只抓新增的

sources: https://codeberg.org/mikf/gallery-dl#installation (python -m pip install -U gallery-dl; brew install gallery-dl)
